title: 17119 - 17119/P0735/001845
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Overloaded Clutch due to continuous high Torque or Tuning
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connections faulty
Sensör Okuma Değerleri Gear Position Indicator faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Values Tutarlılık / Uyumluluk Kontrolü İçin, especially Torque related ones.
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and Connections
Kontrol edin:  Sensör Okuma Değerleri Gear Position Indicator
technicalNotes: The gear monitoring of the transmission Kontrol Modülü checks the gear ratio by comparing transmission input and output speed in regard of the currently selected gear. This fault code is being set when recognizing an implausible transmission ratio.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
